questions.text: Match the nouns (1–4) with their plural forms (A–E).

questions.text: Match the sentences (1–4) with the correct articles (A–D).

questions.text: Match the sentences (1–4) with the correct quantifiers (A–E).

pairs: There are very ___ people here — the hall is almost empty.
